svg.text: 1970s pumper fire engine · the masked arsonist — contestant vehicle dossier
Charred end to end — drove out of a furnace
Chrome bell — the only thing unscorched (rings on his special)
A 1970s pumper fire engine completely blackened
and scorched, a warped fire ladder, one gleaming
polished chrome bell, charred ash-covered metal
and ember marks, realistic game-ready PBR
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~55k tris · PBR 4K
